title: Student Dropout & Attrition Early Warning

engineFeatures.meaning: the cohort the subject joined, used for the time-based split

label: For "Student Dropout & Attrition Early Warning": Identify learners at risk of dropping out weeks ahead and trigger supportive interventions that actually help. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Interventions confound labels.
